profile.reading:
Per Flexential's own individual facility page, this building (Flexential Dallas - Plano) is located at 3500 East Plano Parkway, Plano, TX 75074. The operator publishes a footprint of 261425 square feet and 18 MW of critical load UPS capacity for this specific building, with published certifications and compliance attestations including HITRUST CSF, PCI DSS, SOC 1 Type II, SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, NIST 800-53, ITAR, SSAE 18. ERCOT, the Texas grid operator, forecast in July 2026 that statewide peak power demand would roughly double by 2032, from a record of about 91,308 megawatts set that July to roughly 175,000 megawatts, with ERCOT CEO Pablo Vegas citing "a massive influx of data centers" alongside population and broader economic growth as the dominant driver, per the Texas Tribune. ERCOT identified evening hours, when solar generation stops and battery reserves deplete, as the critical supply gap requiring additional natural gas capacity; Texas responded in 2023 by creating the $10 billion Texas Energy Fund loan program, which has financed 5,000 megawatts of new natural gas generation across eight projects so far, with another 2,300 megawatts under review. Texas solar capacity more than doubled between 2023 and 2025, and battery storage capacity tripled over the same period.

Texas is now forgoing at least $1.3 billion a year in sales tax revenue through its data center exemption, first enacted in 2013 when facilities were far smaller, with the state comptroller projecting the cost will reach $1.8 billion by fiscal year 2030; annual revenue loss ran only $5 million to $30 million from 2014 through 2022 before the post-2023 AI boom drove the sharp increase, according to Texas Tribune reporting. To qualify, smaller facilities of at least 100,000 square feet must create at least 20 jobs paying 120% of the area median salary and invest $200 million over five years, earning up to 15 years of exemption; larger facilities of at least 250,000 square feet must create 40 qualifying jobs, invest $500 million, and reserve 20 megawatts of transmission capacity, earning up to 20 years of exemption. The exemption covers servers, software, cooling systems, generators, plumbing, and electricity costs. State Senator Joan Huffman has called the growing cost "extremely concerning" and unsustainable, and lawmakers have signaled they may pursue repealing or narrowing the exemption, amid broader public skepticism toward new data center construction in several Texas communities.

reading.body:
Flexential Dallas – Plano publishes 18 MW of IT capacity across 261,400 square feet of technical space. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 18 MW supports roughly 450 racks; at 10 kW per rack, a more typical enterprise colocation density, the same power budget reaches about 1,800 racks. The arithmetic is an illustration of range, not an operator claim. The floor area works out to approximately 14 square feet per kilowatt at the higher density and 145 square feet per kilowatt at the lower, suggesting the building was sized for mixed or general-purpose colocation rather than GPU-dense AI training pods, though the published specs do not confirm workload mix or rack density in use.

The certification stack qualifies this campus for a specific set of regulated workloads. SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 cover financial and operational controls auditing. PCI DSS qualifies it for payment card data. ITAR restricts eligible tenants to defense and export-controlled technical data. NIST 800-53 aligns the facility with federal security controls. HITRUST addresses healthcare information. SSAE 18 is the attestation standard underlying the SOC reports. Which tenants are present is not published.

Texas has 133 facilities mapped in this site's dataset, of which only 13 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 389 MW of published IT capacity across the state. Flexential Dallas – Plano's 18 MW ranks ninth among those 13. It holds roughly 4.6 percent of the published Texas total, a mid-tier position in a state where most facilities disclose no capacity figure at all, making the true statewide total unknown.
